critical_code_review_comments: body_temple_launch_email.py:175 — uses asyncio.get_event_loop().time() as a timestamp for 'body_temple_launch_sent_at'. This is the monotonic event-loop clock (seconds since loop start), NOT a wall-clock; you cannot later compare against datetime.utcnow(). Recommend datetime.utcnow().isoformat() so the field is meaningful for downstream analytics or admin reporting. Non-blocking (dry-run path unaffected) but worth fixing before --send.

BodyTemple.jsx:53 — api.get(`/body-temple/day/${activeDay}`) is fired on every setActiveDay; consider caching the day payload (Map keyed by day) so reopening a previously viewed stone is instant. Minor UX polish.

StonePath.jsx — inline <style> tag for stone-pulse keyframes is injected per component instance; if multiple StonePath components mount (4 here) the keyframe rule is duplicated 4x in the DOM. Move to index.css. Cosmetic only.
